_README: Web-researched values for Rhode Island projects, applied FILL-NULLS-ONLY. The agenda is the primary source and is never overwritten. Keyed by 'City|Address' as stored. Developer entries require two independent registrable domains plus a sentence establishing THIS address; single-domain results are marked web_low_confidence. Non-developer fields need one reputable source and store its URL. Excluded sources: LoopNet, Redfin, ZoomInfo, BuildZoom, BLDUP, citizenportal.ai, traded.co, and any aggregator republishing without original reporting.
